patch.value: Gated sync still refuses duplicate GH278 provenance across two delivered records

Latest failing run 41407648593 (2026-11-02T07:38Z); failures repeat daily since 11-01. Reconcile to exactly one canonical import identity while preserving both records' delivery evidence: keep the tag on the record the issue/PR primarily tracks and convert the other link to a structured relationship or dependency (no second gh: tag). A bounded scan found this single repeated key in the tracker corpus.
